people.name: Aaron
people.line: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel

translations.web: “Aaron shall offer the bull of the sin offering, which is for himself, and make atonement for himself and for his house.
translations.bsb: Aaron is to present the bull for his sin offering and make atonement for himself and his household.
translations.kjv: And Aaron shall offer his bullock of the sin offering, which is for himself, and make an atonement for himself, and for his house.
translations.asv: And Aaron shall present the bullock of the sin-offering, which is for himself, and make atonement for himself, and for his house.
